charts.title: TOI-1670 c: orbits around TOI-1670
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1670's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1670 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 40.7501028 d

charts.title: TOI-1670 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1670 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (84, 85, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 441739020, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 22-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 22-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
